decision: On November 26, 2026 Peter approved publishing v0.6.9 with four release verification rows deferred. The decision covers the v0.6.8 cold-user run, full CUDA and Metal device suites, broad parity sweep, and Linux and Darwin quick-full suites. Exact source CI, canonical module pins, public Go proxy verification for all four modules, and release assets and checksums remain required.
required: staged canonical root and standalone checks for CUDA, Vulkan and Metal
public Go proxy and checksum database checks for all four modules
